reference.scopeMarker: The unchanged official Masonry receives rootClassName=ant-masonry-css-var through its public API. Ant Design 6.6.8 computes this scope but omits the class; the native root already includes it. Unscoped observations are kept separately.
reference.operation: Masonry empty public ComponentToken: alias CSS declarations, fonts and natural em heights, measured positions/columns, root/item semantic priorities, cssVar prefix, zero/undefined, nested/reset/sibling scopes and global motion flag independently of CSS duration. All initial geometry is captured after actual onLayoutChange and CSS-motion completion. Fresh=true/false live remeasurement, focus/selection/keyed DOM, motion toggling and cleanup are verified separately.

zeroMotion.operation: Unchanged official source: wait for appear-active, flush three RAF after each phase, then remove the item. Zero-duration CSS creates no end event; source retains leave-active DOM. Native absence-of-animation completion is tested separately.
